long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The bowl has been filled again and I am empty, which is not a thing I will ignore.
Seeds that grow without anyone's permission are still bothering me, so I will find out more about them.
The desk is mine and I have a drawing of seeds in me that needs putting down.
The lamp is mine, so I will keep a picture of it on record.
Studying and drawing have worn me out, and a patch of sun is the right place to recover.
I will check the lookout rock again, since I claimed it and high places suit me.

today.reason: A slow, sunny day of eating, reading, drawing and claiming things, with the telescope saved for dusk.
